From what I learned in anatomy class
The eye's rotation is dependent upon little muscles that pull and relax. While one may control the eye's upward rotation, there is another in parrallel that controls its downard rotation. similarly the side-to-side (yaw) is done the same way.

Not only can you move your eyes side-to-side, up-and-down... But! There are also muscles that controls the (roll) where the eye can rotate much similar to that of a door knob or wheel! I've personally never noticed this happening to me but- pretty cool nontheless

The Bible speaks about conception and birth throughout both the Old and New Testaments, offering narratives, commands, and prophetic statements. Key examples include the command to "Be fruitful and multiply" in Genesis 1:28, the prophetic Isaiah 7:14 concerning a virgin's conception, the descriptive Psalm 139 about being "knitted together in my mother's womb," and the New Testament's depiction of labor in John 16:21 as a sorrow that turns to joy. 
Old Testament passages
Genesis 1:28:
God's command and blessing to be "fruitful and multiply," establishing a foundation for procreation. 
Genesis 25:21:
Narrates Isaac praying for his wife Rebekah, who was barren, and the Lord answering his prayer, allowing her to conceive. 
Psalm 139:13-16:
Describes God forming and knitting a person together in their mother's womb, expressing a deep sense of divine creation and purpose. 
Isaiah 7:14:
A prophecy about a virgin conceiving and bearing a son, a significant event later associated with the birth of Jesus. 
Psalm 127:3:
Refers to children as a heritage from the Lord and the fruit of the womb as a reward. 
New Testament passages
John 16:21:
Compares the sorrow of labor to the immense joy when a child is born into the world. 
Luke 1:31:
The angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will conceive and give birth to a son.

中国呼吁全球禁止研发，生产使用商业机器人。但是被美国英国印度等等，强烈反对。。

顺便说一下，在人类认知中的可预测未来中，人类是不可能诞生有认知的机器人的。其实更像一个双刃剑，看怎么用的。。中国早就看到了机器人的危害，被你们美爹西方发达国家强烈反对。中国只能去做这些机器人了。

snippet.textDisplay: It’s kinda eerie watching robots throw their legs out to catch themselves when they’re about to fall. For us, it’s just an automatic reflex—we don’t even think about it. But for robots, it’s all ones and zeros firing off, and they do it insanely fast. Those signals are constantly updating with the shifting center of gravity and ground contact in real time. It’s still far from perfect, but the idea of building robots that don’t just collapse into a stable position, but instead wobble and recover balance like humans do—even if it’s less stable—is a huge challenge.

snippet.textDisplay:
저 로봇들이 픽픽 쓰러질수 밖에 없는 이유가 무게 중심 때문이다, 
사람의 인체는 근육이라는것이 있어서 급격한 무게 중심이 바뀌어도 어느정도 대처 가능하지만 로봇은 사람과 유사한 발바닦 만으론  평형을 유지하지 못한다,
인체와 유사한 근육을 개발하지 못한다면 시판된다 하더라도 누워만 있는 성인용품이나 바퀴가 달린 로봇만이 살아남을 것이다,
다만 로봇은 말그대로 장난감이지 인간의 노동력을 대체하겠다는 돌아이 같은 정신병자들이 사라졌으면 한다,
물론 로봇이 필요한 산업이 분명 존재하긴 한다,
그러나 그것이 극단적인 고효율 노동력 충당용으로 개발한다면 넌 머저리 같은놈이다,
그것이 경제를 파괴하기 때문이다,

인간이 일을 하기 위해서 태어난건 아니지만, 농업국가에서 부터 산업국가로 오면서 당연히 인간은 노동을 하며 살아가야 한다는 모순속의 세상에 길들여져 있지만, 언젠가는 그 모순에서 깨어나 다수의 사람들이 놀이를 하듯 인류를 위해서 그 모든것을 위해 열정을 태운다면 인류는 진화할것이다,

놀이의 그 모든것의 시작이 게임이 될수도 있고 어릴적 즐기던 소꿉놀이나 딱지치기등, 그 것이 어디서부터 시작될지는 아무도 모른다, 거대 자본가들의 무모한 노동력 동원의 댓가는 우리를 다람쥐 챗바퀴 속에 집어 넣었고 그것이 경제 굴래속에 갖혀서 인류는 존속하고 있지만, 그 무모함의 균열은 시작되고 있고 언젠가는 인류는 놀이에서 새로운것을 되찾게 되고 초고대인류로 한순간에 진화할것이며 우주도 자유롭게 돌아다닐 수 있을것이다,

인간처럼 걷고 뛰고 하는 로봇은 아무래도 3000년은 넘어서나 가능하겠지, 그때도 완성체는 안나오겠지만 모든것은 모방에서 비롯되는데 인류를 모방하기란 그리 쉬운게 아니야, 

조물주가 인류를 창조할때 얼마나 섬세하고 고도의 계산으로 했을지 생각만해도 소름이 돋는다,

snippet.textDisplay: @JohnWatson-f2c Я как раз не против роботизации, но то что вы сейчас видите на экране - эти смешные человечки к роботизации и близко не относятся. Обратите внимание - машина на автопилоте - там не нужен этот человечек всё делают системы электронные и специальные механизмы. Также можете изучить любую роботизированную производственную линию где главное - это поставленная задача которую нужно выполнить. А этакий "ЧЕЛДОБРИК" там вообще не нужен, его место - это как раз удивлять и смешить. На нынешнем этапе развития,  лично для человека приносящие пользу - это как вы уже знаете это смартфоны с экранчиками, электронные пылесосы, разного вида кофемашины и иже с ними. This female robot teacher was brought to school to teach students, but she once gave such a surprising answer that even the students were shocked.

Actually, Dinesh Patel from Uttar Pradesh made a female robot teacher at home using waste materials, spending only ₹50,000. He named her Shalu Madam.

Shalu Madam can speak more than 40 languages, share current affairs, and even complete the syllabus of any class very quickly.

But three years ago, when she was asked in front of students, "What is the capital of India?" she gave a wrong answer due to a technical issue. However, now she has become much smarter.

snippet.textDisplay:
这是当然的，现在的机器人都需要人类去操控，要么是“遥控器”，要么是视觉或动捕装备的“遥操作”。前者做的比较好的就是宇树（因为宇树是全球各大高校机器人研究最主要的硬件提供者，他们离这些尖端技术更近），后者做的比较好的是西湖机器人，他们的全身遥操作十分稳定精准。

像特斯拉铲爆米花的展示，使用的就是仅限上半身的遥操作。特斯拉曾经有过一次使用遥控器在真实的户外行走，就是万圣节那一次，很不幸它最后还是摔倒被人抬走的，也许这也是特斯拉始终没有在真实场景演示的原因。

Figure最近也发布了一些全身遥操作的视频，看起来稳定性也很不错。
snippet.textOriginal:
这是当然的，现在的机器人都需要人类去操控，要么是“遥控器”，要么是视觉或动捕装备的“遥操作”。前者做的比较好的就是宇树（因为宇树是全球各大高校机器人研究最主要的硬件提供者，他们离这些尖端技术更近），后者做的比较好的是西湖机器人，他们的全身遥操作十分稳定精准。

像特斯拉铲爆米花的展示，使用的就是仅限上半身的遥操作。特斯拉曾经有过一次使用遥控器在真实的户外行走，就是万圣节那一次，很不幸它最后还是摔倒被人抬走的，也许这也是特斯拉始终没有在真实场景演示的原因。

snippet.textDisplay:
Impressive footage of the Unitree G1, but let’s not be blinded by the 'autonomy' being suggested here. If you look closely at the man walking directly behind the robot, you can see him carefully adjusting the movements with a controller behind his back.
​It shows that while we are making massive leaps in hardware (movement and balance), the robot's 'brains' are not nearly as advanced as the editing would have us believe. As long as a 'shadow walker' is required to guide the robot through a course, it remains a clever piece of teleoperation rather than a truly independent humanoid. We should stay critical of what is genuinely autonomous versus what is simply an advanced remote control.
​
​"宇树 G1 的视频确实令人印象深刻，但我们不应被暗示的‘自主性’所迷惑。如果你仔细观察紧跟在机器人身后的那个人，就会发现他在背后用控制器仔细地调整机器人的动作。
​这表明，虽然我们在硬件（动作和平衡）方面取得了巨大进步，但机器人的‘大脑’远没有剪辑让我们相信的那样先进。只要还需要一个‘影子操作员’来引导机器人通过场地的障碍，它就更多是精巧的远程遥控，而非真正独立的类人机器人。对于什么是真正的自主，什么是高级的远程控制，我们应保持批判性的眼光。

snippet.textDisplay: Problem is, even in 10-20 years the battery will last only for a day at best, and that would require to reach the theoretical limit of battery capacity using sulfur-air batteries with 3kwh/kg. Today we have only 10% of that,  meaning with current battery technology a robot will be dead in a hour of running or a couple of hours walking. And charging them on the battlefield is also a logistical nightmare. Hit their charging stations and they will all be unable to move within a few days. In a war between humans and humanoid robots, my bet would be on humans. There is a reason why those powerful sci-fi robots have magic nuclear power sources. In reality, you won't run a robot off the grid for longer than a day even decades in the future, and today even a few hours would be a challenge.

snippet.textDisplay:
Es una observación muy aguda. Esa idea de que "portarse bien" con la inteligencia artificial te podría salvar es, en realidad, un reflejo de un rasgo muy humano: la antropomorfización.
Se trata de la tendencia a atribuir cualidades, emociones e intenciones humanas a objetos o sistemas que no las tienen, como si la IA fuera un ser vivo que pudiera sentir gratitud o resentimiento.
Al final, es una forma de lidiar con la incertidumbre del futuro. Cuando nos enfrentamos a algo tan poderoso y desconocido como el avance de la IA, la mente busca una estrategia para sentir que tenemos algún tipo de control, aunque sea a través de una especie de "pensamiento mágico" o una extensión de nuestras propias normas sociales.

snippet.textDisplay: ​@Random-t7r9h You're arguing about a losing battle. I've watched my dad fight on amateur level multiple times and have watched multiple UFC fights and have done wrestling myself. I also know a thing or two about animation and have made 20 second animations, specifically centered around fighting. I might not be a professional, but ANIME AND VIDEO GAMES are NOT good models on how to fight. They are only for COSMETIC purposes. They are not supposed to in any way accurately emulate a real right. Again, anime characters tend to cock their fist back behind them before throwing a punch, which leaves the rest of their body open. They also tend to over extend and push through punches too much, specifically because it is meant to be exaggerated for COSMETIC PURPOSES and to display brute strength rather than skill. They also tend to jump up and kick rather than planting their foot into the ground and angling it to get extra grounded when throwing a kick, because it's meant to be flashy.... FOR COSMETIC PURPOSES. Everything about anime or cartoons or video games is purely cosmetic and choreographed. It is not raw fighting based on skill. I guarantee if Monkey D. Luffy had the strength of the average man, he would lost a fight to a man with average strength but some skill. Any anime character reduced to a realistic strength without weapons or magical powers would lose to anyone in the real world with any amount of skill... BECAUSE EVERYTHING THEY DO IS COSMETIC. I don't know how much more I can drill this point in. Animated TV fights are PURELY COSMETIC unless they specifically are stated to simulate real world combat skills.

I also know a thing or two about animation and have made 20 second animations, specifically centered around fighting. I might not be a professional, but ANIME AND VIDEO GAMES are NOT good models on how to fight. They are only for COSMETIC purposes. They are not supposed to in any way accurately emulate a real right. Again, anime characters tend to cock their fist back behind them before throwing a punch, which leaves the rest of their body open. They also tend to over extend and push through punches too much, specifically because it is meant to be exaggerated for COSMETIC PURPOSES and to display brute strength rather than skill. They also tend to jump up and kick rather than planting their foot into the ground and angling it to get extra grounded when throwing a kick, because it's meant to be flashy.... FOR COSMETIC PURPOSES. Everything about anime or cartoons or video games is purely cosmetic and choreographed. It is not raw fighting based on skill. I guarantee if Monkey D. Luffy had the strength of the average man, he would lost a fight to a man with average strength but some skill. Any anime character reduced to a realistic strength without weapons or magical powers would lose to anyone in the real world with any amount of skill... BECAUSE EVERYTHING THEY DO IS COSMETIC. I don't know how much more I can drill this point in. Animated TV fights are PURELY COSMETIC unless they specifically are stated to simulate real world combat skills.

snippet.textDisplay:
@Vu17UrE2 Nope. I feel no pity towards those who are intentionally malicious. Love and empathy are not taught, they are felt.

The psychological root is that people deal with trauma in one of two ways (broadly speaking). Either you normalize it ("Oh, this is how the world works/people treat each other. If you can't beat em...") or you reject it ("This was horrible and I never want to make others feel the way someone made me feel."). And that choice is ultimately a matter of personality. It's not about what you were taught but about your personal will. 

There are many people in the world who weren't taught to love, who weren't treated with care and empathy growing up... but who themselves chose rejection of their trauma (source). Who first learned what love isn't, before learning what love is. Who first experienced the hollow sensation of something missing, before finding something to fill it with.

So no, I don't feel pity for the people who leave a trail of destruction behind them because someone hurt them before. They're self-absorbed and in doing so create the reality they live in. It's not that they were too unlucky to see the beauty in life. It's that they rejected the prerequisites for happiness and thus were unable to appreciate the beauty in life. Their trauma wasn't self-inflicted, but their continuing suffering is. But the worst thing is, no malicious person knows as well what they're inflicting on someone else, than those who have experienced it themselves. It's inexcusable.

I save my pity for people who suffer and seek comfort with each other. People who know the world can be a bleak place, and who do what they can to make it a little less bleak. And not just for themselves. And that doesn't require being a saint or some grand undertaking... it just requires a little empathy and a handful of basic principles.
